evidence.title: The Measurement Revolution? Credible Measurement and Inference in the Age of AI

summary: Researchers introduce a novel methodology to evaluate AI models with rigorous statistical guarantees, aiming to improve transparency and reliability across deployments. The approach, dubbed “Credible Measurement,” combines Bayesian inference with robust validation to address current gaps in AI evaluation.
title: New Framework Promises Credible Measurement and Inference for AI Systems
